quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only flows one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is under repair or maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead is under repair or maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction zones ahead. Be ready to slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is a traffic regulation you must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive with extra care in this area.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go before you.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points downward, it means they are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
You may go if the road is clear.
You must stop completely before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way and could hit another vehicle head-on. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers that there is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that shows a rule you must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if traffic is coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on crossing roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass. Go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from bottom to top: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Look both ways, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only move when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows you can either turn right or continue straight from this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the speed shown (35 mph) for safety.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. What should you do?

options.text: Honk at cars entering the freeway.
Change lanes if safe to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes if safe to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if you can do so safely. This gives entering vehicles space.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down and let any trains pass. Trains cannot stop for cars.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road conditions ahead.
It helps you find cities and towns.
It tells you about traffic laws.
It warns you about road construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on yellow. They tell you about conditions and hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to drive carefully when the road is wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only goes in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only goes in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only flow in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and yield to other traffic.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down as you approach it. Be ready to stop if needed. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming steep hill. Adjust your speed to drive safely over the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overhead structure ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to bear right or left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders in the group should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Only pennant-shaped signs are used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross at this location. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic moves on this street. You must drive in the direction shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers a school zone is coming. You should slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does this mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops instead of turn signals. Left arm bent at the elbow with hand pointing up means the rider plans to turn right or move right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm with their index finger extended?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm with index finger extended, it means all riders should move into a single line.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, it is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells other riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about dangerous road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about dangerous road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or travel near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any cars or pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, the riders behind should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road hazards ahead. This sign warns of a sharp turn coming. Slow down when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue straight or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue straight.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You can change lanes to continue straight, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on a bridge over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road will cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way sections separated by a median. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that the road will curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves to the left. Multiple chevron signs may be placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign shows that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that traffic will merge onto the road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at this exact speed.
The maximum legal speed is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum legal speed for that road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has sharp turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and increase the distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if it is quick.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey them. This sign means passing is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the center line or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What is the main danger of this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control if a wheel drops onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if a wheel drops onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the side, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points it upward, it means they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: From top to bottom, traffic lights are arranged in this order:
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On horizontal signals, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it means:

options.text: They are about to slow down.

questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the side, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is ahead and you should prepare to stop completely before going forward.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign tells drivers to slow down at intersections and be ready to stop. You must yield to other drivers and pedestrians. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Cars in the right lane must move left to merge with traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Yield to pedestrians and approaching cars. Only stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.
